metrics: transcoder_auto_restarts_total COUNTER {} FFmpeg auto-restart attempts charged to a session's restart budget (a playlist or segment request found the run dead).
transcoder_ffmpeg_exits_total COUNTER {reason} FFmpeg process exits, by how: ok (status 0), error (non-zero status), signal (terminated by a signal).

transcoder_ffmpeg_failures_total COUNTER {cause} Failed runs (runs_total{outcome=failed}) by the cause read off FFmpeg's stderr: subtitle_bitmap, no_decoder, timestamps, invalid_data, source, signal, other.
transcoder_playlist_wait_seconds HISTOGRAM {kind} Time until a playlist appeared, successful waits only, by kind.
transcoder_playlist_waits_total COUNTER {kind,outcome} Waits for a playlist to appear, by outcome (ok, timeout, not_running, canceled) and kind (variant, subtitle).
transcoder_restart_limit_reached_total COUNTER {} Sessions that exhausted the auto-restart budget and were answered 503 (once per session, like the log line).

transcoder_run_first_segment_seconds HISTOGRAM {mode,start} Time from FFmpeg's start to the first segment of the primary stream (its playlist appearing), by mode (copy, reencode, audio) and start (start, seek). Runs that end before it are not counted.
transcoder_run_pause_seconds_total COUNTER {mode} Time FFmpeg processes spent frozen by pacing (ahead of every viewer by the pace lead), by mode.

transcoder_run_resume_segment_seconds HISTOGRAM {mode} Time from pacing letting a frozen FFmpeg go (SIGCONT) to it starting the next primary segment, by mode. Resumes that never get one are only in run_resume_stalls_total.
transcoder_run_resume_stalls_total COUNTER {mode} Resumes after which FFmpeg started no new primary segment within 30 s, by mode; counted once, when the 30 s pass.
transcoder_run_speed HISTOGRAM {mode} FFmpeg's speed (media time over wall time) when a run ends, for runs that produced at least 30 s of media, by mode. Below 1 the viewer outruns the transcoder.
transcoder_runs_active GAUGE {} FFmpeg processes currently running.
transcoder_runs_paused GAUGE {} FFmpeg processes currently frozen by pacing.

transcoder_runs_total COUNTER {outcome} FFmpeg processes that ended, by why: finished (source fully transcoded), released_idle (reaped after the grace period), killed (stopped by us for another reason), failed (died on its own).
transcoder_sessions_active GAUGE {} Sessions currently held by the session manager (idle ones included until the 10-minute expiry).
transcoder_source_open_seconds HISTOGRAM {outcome} Time to probe a source (its first read; cached probe results are not counted), by outcome.
